selection.rationale: The complete six-cell development comparison has only BNoLM meeting every prespecified constraint: overall 10.1724%, short 7.4803%, long 10.6686% WER, no output/context caps or exceptions. Every other candidate has more output-limit stops than A; ASplit also worsens short WER. Selection uses seed183 only; seed184 is a subsequent sensitivity check and will not select a different primary training seed or method.
selection.missingness_review: All six systems have the same 45 texts x generation seeds 17 and 42, 90 scored terminal attempts each. Paired common-success and shared-attempted counts are 90, with no unmatched pairs or missing scores; full-deletion sensitivity equals scored results. Caps remain included. ASR and text-source uncertainty, selection optimism, and unmeasured human quality remain limitations.
